description: Test vectors for the SentiLab view envelope, DRAFT v0.5 (view-envelope-0.5.md). Generated by `node run-view-vectors.mjs --write` and checked by `node run-view-vectors.mjs`. Chains give the core's input, how the envelopes reach the view as JSONL, the run the view requested, its pins and served keys, the envelopes, a hand-written expect block and the full verifyJsonl() result.

rules.input_checks: in order, before anything is hashed: (1) a JSONL line is at most 65,536 raw bytes; (2) parse; (3) structure, iteratively: depth at most 8 (the envelope is level 1, only objects and arrays count), strings and keys well-formed UTF-16 with at most 512 code points, finite numbers, at most 64 entries in values.geometry, values.center_temps and values.artifact_hashes, and the schema; (4) canonical size at most 65,536 bytes, measured without calling canonical(). A failure is one row with status oversize or malformed and is never passed to canonical(), hashed, signed or verified
rules.transport: an API response is at most 256 lines and 4 MiB (4,194,304 bytes); a replay file is at most 64 MiB; both are checked before parsing
rules.canonical: canonical() from ../contract-0.2/resultcheck.mjs; for these values it equals RFC 8785 (JCS). Absent fields are omitted, never undefined or null
rules.hash: sha256(canonical(envelope without sig and hash)), lowercase hex, recomputed from the content by the verifier
rules.prev_hash: the stored hash of an envelope at the previous seq; the first is sha256("sentilab-view-genesis:" + the run_id the view requested)
rules.run: an envelope whose run.run_id differs from the run the view requested is run_mismatch
rules.sig: Ed25519 over the 64 hex characters of the recomputed hash as UTF-8; sig.value is lowercase hex, 128 characters
rules.seq: 1, 2, 3, ... in seq order; a seq that isn't one more than the previous is seq_gap, and only that envelope is flagged
rules.duplicates: envelopes with identical canonical bytes (sig and hash included) are one envelope; the copies make no row
rules.conflicts: different envelopes in the same run sharing a seq (seq_conflict) or an event_id (event_id_conflict); every one involved is flagged
rules.ordering: rows are in seq order; at one seq, rejected rows first, then envelopes by stored hash; rows whose seq can't be read come last
rules.projection: the projectable prefix is the leading run of verified rows; prefix_end K is its last seq (0 if none); the board is project() over exactly those events; when anything follows, frozen is true and label is "chain broken after seq K; board frozen at seq K"; if project() throws, projection is null and projection_error is project_threw
rules.mode: api: LIVE when a poll succeeded within 5 s and the projectable prefix K last grew within 60 s (client clock, inclusive, never in the future), with the label "LIVE · progress N s ago"; otherwise STALE; file: REPLAY
rules.roles: actor_role is lab, core or acceptance_gate; actor.lab gate goes with acceptance_gate; only the gate writes accepted, non_improving_current and within_margin
rules.key_sha256: sha256 of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key (the last 32 bytes of its SPKI DER), lowercase hex
rules.test_keys: seed = sha256("sentilab-view-test-key:" + name) (32 bytes); private key = Ed25519 from that seed, i.e. PKCS8 DER 302e020100300506032b657004220420 || seed
rules.after_signing: set the value at path in the envelope with that seq, after it was signed
rules.replace_from_fork: build the same chain with entry fork_seq's ts set to fork_ts, then put that chain's envelope take_seq in place of ours
rules.also: build these entries as separate chains with the same run and signer, and add their envelopes
rules.drop_seqs: sign the whole chain, then leave the envelopes with these seqs out
rules.send: pad: insert spaces after the opening brace of that seq's JSON line until it is line_bytes; orders: deliver the envelopes in each order (by event_id); twice: send every line twice
rules.append_checks: false means a faulty writer: makeChain skips every check the core makes and signs whatever it is given

reason_codes.run_mismatch: run.run_id differs from the run the view requested
reason_codes.seq_gap: seq is not the previous seq + 1 (or not 1 for the first)
reason_codes.seq_conflict: another, different envelope in the same run has this seq
reason_codes.event_id_conflict: another, different envelope in the same run has this event_id
reason_codes.prev_hash_mismatch: prev_hash is not the stored hash of an envelope at the previous seq (or the genesis value)
reason_codes.hash_mismatch: the stored hash is not the hash recomputed from the content
reason_codes.key_not_pinned: sig.key_id is not among the page's pins
reason_codes.key_unavailable: pinned, but no key was served for that key_id
reason_codes.key_hash_mismatch: the served key's sha256 doesn't match the pin
reason_codes.bad_sig: the signature doesn't verify over the recomputed hash

input_check_codes.line_too_large: oversize: the raw line is over 65,536 bytes (step 1; never parsed)
input_check_codes.too_deep: oversize: an object or array below level 8 (step 3)
input_check_codes.lone_surrogate: malformed: a string or key that isn't well-formed UTF-16 (step 3)
input_check_codes.string_too_long: oversize: a string or key over 512 code points (step 3)
input_check_codes.non_finite_number: malformed: a number that is NaN or infinite (step 3)
input_check_codes.too_many_entries:<field>: oversize: over 64 entries in values.geometry, values.center_temps or values.artifact_hashes (step 3)
input_check_codes.invalid_value: malformed: not a JSON value, e.g. undefined, possible only for in-memory input (step 3)
input_check_codes.schema:<path>: malformed: the schema doesn't hold at that path (step 3)

hashing.name: values absent, undefined and null: undefined and null both canonicalize to null, so neither hashes like absent
hashing.round_trip: sign the envelope with values: undefined in memory, then JSON.stringify and JSON.parse it, which drops the key

canonical.name: keys sorted, no whitespace, 5.0 written as 5
keys sorted by UTF-16 code units: U+1F600 (D83D DE00) sorts before U+FF21
strings as JSON.stringify: non-ASCII stays as is, control characters are escaped
